PokémonXP & 2026 Worlds

Event
Starts:
Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 10:00 AM Local Time
Ends:
Sunday, August 30, 2026, at  8:00 PM Local Time

Celebrate PokémonXP and the 2026 Pokémon World Championships in Pokémon GO!

The PokémonXP & 2026 Worlds event will take place from August 25, 2026 at 10 am to August 30, 2026 at 8 pm local time.

PokémonXP: Tuesday, August 25, at 10:00 a.m. to Friday, August 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. local time.

2026 Pokémon World Championships: Friday, August 28, at 10:00 a.m. to Sunday, August 30, at 8:00 p.m. local time.

Advertisement


Bonuses

The maximum number of sets you can play per day will increase from five to 15—for a total of 75 battles.
Pokémon encountered via GO Battle League rewards will have a wider variance of Attack, Defense, and HP.

Features

Pokémon Debut

New costumed Pokémon will appear during this event!

  • Pikachu wearing a Cosmog-themed spacesuit
  • World Championships 2026 Pikachu

Crowning a World Champion!

The 2026 Pokémon World Championships will take place from August 28 to 30, 2026, in San Francisco, California.

The top qualifying Pokémon GO players from around the globe will compete to determine who will be crowned the 2026 Pokémon GO World Champion!

Among other prizes, the Pokémon GO World Champion will receive the World Champion 2026 outfit for their avatar!

Tune in to watch live!

Tune in and watch all the action beginning at 9:00 a.m. PDT each day!

English Stream:

  • Day 1: Pokémon GO Twitch Channel
  • Day 2: Pokémon GO Twitch Channel
  • Day 3: Pokémon Twitch Channel

Watching the livestreams can also earn you Timed Research and other rewards via Twitch Drops. Learn more about the drops here.

Avatar Items to Celebrate

Keep your eyes on the broadcast—we’ll display a code for the following T-shirt for your avatar!

  • 2026 Worlds Tee (Green): Available globally via a code shared during the World Championships stream.

World Championships battlegrounds return in the GO Battle League!

In celebration of the 2026 Pokémon World Championships, the GO Battle League will feature a different arena and background battle music between August 24 at 12:00 p.m. PDT and August 30, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. PDT.

GO Pass

GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe

A GO Pass is a free, limited-time progression track available during a specified period. By collecting GO Points, you can increase your rank to earn rewards.

Trainers will automatically receive GO Pass: PokémonXP & 2026 Worlds on Tuesday, August 25, at 10:00 a.m. local time. You can collect GO Points and rank up to get additional rewards through Sunday, August 30, at 8:00 p.m. local time.

Additionally, from Saturday, August 29, at 12:00 a.m. to Sunday, August 30, at 7:59 p.m. local time, there’s no daily limit for how many GO Points you can earn!

For US$4.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass that offers upgraded rewards and faster progression.

For US$6.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe + 6 Ranks to also automatically earn enough GO Points to reach Rank 7.

While progressing through the GO Pass Deluxe, you’ll be able to claim all of the rewards from both the free GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe. You can upgrade to a GO Pass Deluxe at any time and still collect rewards from previously unlocked ranks.

Rewards unlocked in the GO Pass will expire on Tuesday, September 1, at 7:59 p.m. local time, so be sure to claim your rewards before they’re gone!

*All prices listed are in USD or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency.

Featured Pokémon and Rewards

Complete Pass Tasks to rank up your GO Pass to earn the following.

  • Encounters with event-themed Pokémon

Trainers who upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe can also earn the following rewards.

  • 2026 Worlds/PokémonXP Backpack*
  • Encounter with Zapdos**
  • Additional encounters with event-themed Pokémon
  • And even more goodies!

*The 2026 Worlds/PokémonXP Backpack will also be available to purchase in the in-game shop after the event ends.

**Zapdos encountered via GO Pass: PokémonXP & 2026 Worlds will have a wider variance of Attack, Defense, and HP.

Major Milestone Bonuses

Reach Major Milestones on your GO Pass to unlock the following bonuses.

Tier 1 Bonus Starting at Rank 10

2× Stardust for catching Pokémon.

Tier 2 Bonus Starting at Rank 20

An additional 3,000 XP from raids.

Upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe to strengthen the following bonus:

Receive up to two additional free Raid Passes from spinning Gym Photo Discs.

How to Earn Points

Earn points to increase your rank and unlock rewards. You can earn points by completing Pass Tasks and bonus tasks during the event.

Any rewards you earn for completing a Pass Task will be awarded as soon as you finish the task.

Trainers can earn up to 500 extra points daily by completing certain tasks.

  • Win a raid - 100 PTS
  • Hatch an Egg - 40 PTS
  • Catch a Pokémon - 5 PTS

There is also a daily task:

  • Catch 10 Pokémon - 100 PTS
